summary: Comprehensive testing of payment status & analytics features completed. Backend: 100% pass (10/10 tests). Frontend: 100% pass (21/21 features). All new features working correctly: payment_status field (paid/pending), dual save buttons, analytics dashboard with monthly/yearly breakdown, Today's Roster, payment status badges, and toggle functionality.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated, should use 'boxShadow'
react_native_issues.note: Cosmetic warning only, not breaking functionality. Same as iteration 1.

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ payment_status field added to CaseCreate and CaseResponse models with default 'pending'
✅ PATCH /api/cases/{id}/payment-status endpoint validates status values (paid/pending only)
✅ GET /api/analytics endpoint correctly calculates monthly and yearly stats
✅ Analytics correctly separates received (paid) and pending amounts
✅ Dual save buttons (Save — Paid, Save — Pending) properly set payment_status
✅ Calculator renamed to 'Standard Fee Calculator' throughout UI
✅ Today's Roster section shows cases for current date with time from created_at
✅ Case cards display Paid/Pending badges with correct colors (green/orange)
✅ Analytics page has Month/Year toggle working correctly
✅ Payment status toggle button on case detail page works (PATCH API integration)
✅ Monthly breakdown shows progress bars and correct stats
✅ All MongoDB _id fields properly excluded from responses
✅ All new endpoints follow existing patterns (async/await, error handling)
✅ All new UI components have proper testID attributes
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Test cases were created during testing and cleaned up afterward.
